name: Chronicles of Omniluxia
storyline:
The continent of Omniluxia Ages ago world have been completely different although it has has changed completely after one event. great empire of Gellaius and great Northern alliance have gone to war. Those days the imperial poets have prised the emperor for rising the banners to regain the control over northern territories. Which have had been lost about an age ago when empire have crumbled from outside attacks. The war has been long and loses of the both sides were higher than it could have ever been estimated even in the worst scenario however the northern alliance has been slowly pushed back and in the end of the 668 L.C. the armies of Gellaius empire started siege of the high capital of the alliance.No one could knew that one mad mage could change fate of whole world completely. Most of alliance have surrendered and acknowledged the territorial lose, however one nation stated strong and kept the attackers off, the great city of Petramonis the north star was capitol of the strongest nation within the northern alliance. Nation of Aramal has defended their capitol for 2 years. In the beginning of the 670 L.C. the world have trembled, magical wave have shattered Omniluxia into few smaller continents.The one who is responsible for the disaster have been mage who preformed ritual to stop the imperial capture of the Petramonis royal castle. Ritual have reached all magicans in the reach of the capital and surrounding area most of them started to resonate with magical power and eventually their arcane power have been gathered in the mage who started the ritual no one now knows how much power was unleashed that day but it had power to disolve solid land and move continents apart.After this events most of the nation of Aramal has no longer existed emperor have flew with the mage who have not been touched with this course and shielded him. Emperor had return to the capitol after long journey through the collapsing and shapeshifitng lands. He’s miraculous return have been celebrated. His brother who became new emperor, let him rule the western part of the empire which have separated from the main part of it old emperor decided to agree to that proposal and became western emperor.Current situation of world

Now its year 1001 L.C. those old days have marked history with blood and fear. Magic is now strictly controlled in the empire to not let this tragedy happen again however imperial influence have shortened through the years and now its only a shadow of it former self. Many nations have inherited the aversion to magic since of the great collapse. But today is a bit brighter and magic is not viewed as only mean of destruction. The new religion which aims to achive peace and claims that god created world from pure love is spreading acrose world Nations across old omniluxia have been forced to migrate this process have almost ended now this migrations have changed how world look both politically and cultural. Eagellia(eastern empire) is on the point when very big changes may happen. the old dynasty of Gellaians is heir less, current old emperor seams to be to old for extending dynasty further. So the side part of the Gellaius dynasty started preparations to size the power over the empire either through the peaceful resolution or a civil war.
summary:
Chronicles of Omniluxia is a total conversion mod set in the original fantasy world of Omniluxia. Every aspect of the game has been entirely overhauled to fit the new early medieval fantasy setting.

Omniluxia was originally released in 2019 and over the last year we have picked it back up and spent countless hours getting the mod into great shape for release with tons of new content, flavor, bug fixes, and map improvments.
